title: INTERNAL ERROR report
body:
Hi,

I get the following error when I run

    mypy --ignore-missing-imports --follow-imports=silent @typechecked-files --no-strict-optional --show-traceback

from the root of [Sockeye](https://github.com/awslabs/sockeye/). I am not sure how to fix it or what causes it. Can you help?
